description: Test the second 20-union difference band in the shared feed-forward output map
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,704 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 29 prior macro-attempts and 407 prior micro-trials in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0085/micro-0020 at 1,704 parameters and 99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0086/micro-0001, whose next FF-input union scored 3.82% at 1,703 parameters and was rolled back. Hypothesis: the sharp FF-input boundary is site-specific; the FF-output map's next pair has a lower distortion scale and residual reconstruction may tolerate a second band. Ordering remains ascending absolute current FF-output group difference, recomputed after each keep. This parameterization-preserving compression is more informative than excluding the failed FF-input pair because it tests the complementary path under a smaller perturbation and directly distinguishes input versus output sensitivity. Each micro-trial adds one FF-output union and the official runner alone accepts or rolls back. Stop on the first scored discard or error, at 20 micro-trials, or if no pair remains. Compute budget: at most 20 checkpoint migrations and official verifications or 30 wall-clock minutes.
summary: Evaluated 10 unions in the second FF-output band. The first 9 qualified and were retained, moving the frontier from 1,704 parameters at 99.01% to 1,695 parameters at 99.03%; micro-0010 proposed 1,694 parameters and scored 98.99%, so it was discarded and rolled back. Outcomes: 9 accepts, 1 scored discard, 0 errors. Compute used checkpoint migration plus 10 official verifications over 11m54s wall clock. Stop reason: first scored failure closed the FF-output path before the 20-trial/30-minute cap.
